regulatory_notes: Comply with Visa/Mastercard surcharge vs dual-pricing signage rules, Durbin debit restrictions and state surcharge laws.
Observe FinCEN/Reg E ATM disclosures and sponsor-bank ISO underwriting standards.

plays.name: Wholesale ISO Schedule A Interchange-Plus vs. Compliant Dual-Pricing & ATM Residual Spread
plays.mechanism: Negotiate sponsor-approved ISO Schedule A buy-rates with low markup over interchange and network assessments, then earn disclosed processing residual spreads through compliant dual-pricing or cash-discount POS deployments and exclusive venue ATMs. Pursue recurring basis-point and surcharge income for the contractual residual term; no lifetime payout or universal debit surcharge permission is assumed.
inputs: Executed sponsor-bank or processor ISO agreement and Schedule A defining buy-rates, residual ownership, reserves and termination rights
Merchant-approved POS configuration with legally reviewed cash and card pricing, signage, receipts and debit treatment
Exclusive venue ATM agreements with compliant fee disclosures, approved cash sourcing and remote operational telemetry
workflow: 1. Negotiate and document processing buy-rates, residual calculations, sponsor approval and enforceable payout and portfolio rights.
2. Underwrite merchants and configure genuine dual pricing or cash discounts under current network, debit and local-law requirements.
3. Deploy approved POS terminals and venue ATMs with clear customer disclosures, PCI controls and reconciled settlement and cash processes.
4. Audit monthly residuals and ATM surcharges against transaction reports, track attrition and correct pricing or disclosure exceptions promptly.
metrics: Net retained processing basis points after Schedule A costs, assessments and adjustments
Monthly net ATM surcharge contribution after venue splits, cash servicing and network costs
Merchant retention rate and residual statement reconciliation variance

platform_risks.failure_mode: Pricing misconfiguration or noncompliant disclosures trigger sponsor or card-network enforcement
platform_risks.trigger: Prohibited debit surcharge, misleading cash-discount presentation or unapproved merchant processing activity
platform_risks.impact: Refund obligations, fines, residual withholding and merchant or ISO termination
platform_risks.detection_metric: Pricing audit exceptions, customer fee complaints and sponsor compliance notices
platform_risks.fallback: Disable the disputed pricing configuration, restore approved transparent pricing and remediate with the sponsor before resuming the program

plays.name: High-Risk Payment Orchestration, MID Cascading & Payfac ISO Spread Arbitrage
plays.mechanism: Operating a wholesale high-risk Independent Sales Organization (ISO) and smart payment-orchestration gateway across 25–60 domestic and offshore acquiring banks for verticals banned by Stripe/PayPal (telehealth GLP-1s/peptides, nutra subscriptions, sweepstakes gaming, high-ticket coaching, AI companions)—buying wholesale processing at ~2.10% and charging merchants 5.50%–8.90% + rolling reserves while automatically cascading declines and deflecting pre-dispute chargebacks.
inputs: Wholesale ISO / Payfac sponsorship agreements across 20+ high-risk domestic and international acquiring banks and EMIs
Smart payment-orchestration router (NMI / Spreedly / proprietary vault) supporting multi-MID load balancing, BIN-based routing, and automatic decline cascading
Integrated Verifi CDRN / Ethoca / RDR (Rapid Dispute Resolution) pre-chargeback interception pipeline
workflow: Onboard high-volume DTC, subscription, telehealth, and gaming merchants rejected or frozen by mainstream aggregators
Underwrite and provision each merchant with a diversified cluster of 3–8 dedicated Merchant IDs (MIDs) across distinct acquiring banks
Route live checkout transactions through the orchestration vault—matching card BINs to the highest-approval acquirer and automatically re-trying soft declines on secondary MIDs

Auto-refund disputed transactions via Ethoca/Verifi RDR alerts before they register as formal Visa/Mastercard chargebacks, keeping every MID below the 0.90% VAMP threshold while collecting 300–550 bps in recurring net processing residuals
metrics: Monthly Gross Processing Volume (GPV $) and net retained residual spread (300–550 bps)
Post-RDR net chargeback ratio (<0.65% across all active MIDs)
Cross-MID authorization approval lift (+8–18% over single-processor setups)

platform_risks.failure_mode: Acquiring bank MID termination or Visa VAMP / Mastercard ECM excessive-chargeback fine
platform_risks.trigger: Merchant fulfillment failure or deceptive continuity billing spiking raw disputes above 0.90%–1.50%
platform_risks.impact: Frozen merchant rolling reserve or MATCH-list placement of the offending merchant entity
platform_risks.detection_metric: Real-time Early Fraud Warning (EFW / TC40 / SAFE) ratio and mandatory RDR auto-refund activation at 0.50% dispute velocity
platform_risks.fallback: Enforce mandatory 10% rolling reserves, automated Verifi RDR pre-dispute refunds, 3DS2 step-up authentication on high-risk BINs, and strict merchant descriptor transparency

plays.name: B2B Commercial Virtual Card (VCC) Interchange & AP Settlement Rebate Arbitrage
plays.mechanism: Embedding a 'Free Automated Accounts Payable (AP) / Instant Vendor Settlement' platform inside high-volume B2B verticals (freight brokerage, construction general contracting, medical supply, property management, media agencies) that converts checks and ACH payables into single-use Visa/Mastercard Commercial Virtual Credit Cards (VCCs)—capturing 140–195 basis points (1.40%–1.95%) in uncapped commercial interchange rebates on hundreds of millions in third-party invoice volume.
inputs: BaaS / Commercial Card Issuing bank partnership (Marqeta, Lithic, Stripe Issuing, Highnote, Cross River) on uncapped Visa/Mastercard Large-Ticket & Purchasing interchange tiers
ERP/accounting connector (QuickBooks, NetSuite, Sage, McLeod/TMW freight TMS) ingesting open vendor AP ledgers
Automated vendor-enablement call/email engine pitching 'Day-1 Instant Payment via Virtual Card vs. Net-45 Check/ACH'
workflow: Onboard mid-market companies with $20M–$250M/yr in fragmented vendor payables onto a $0-cost AP automation and working-capital portal
Cross-reference their vendor master list against Visa/Mastercard supplier-acceptance networks to flag vendors that already accept card payments
Offer remaining vendors immediate Day-1 invoice settlement via single-use emailed/API virtual card in exchange for waiving Net-30/Net-60 wait times
Earn 1.50%–1.95% gross interchange rebate from the issuing bank on every settled dollar, sharing 0.25%–0.50% with the corporate client while retaining 1.10%–1.45% net platform margin
metrics: Total annualized Gross Payment Volume (GPV $) converted from ACH/check to Virtual Card (target: 25–45% of total AP)
Net retained interchange spread in basis points (110–145 bps) after bank processor fees and client revenue share
Vendor card-acceptance retention rate (%) across repeat monthly invoices

platform_risks.failure_mode: Vendor card-surcharging pushback or Visa/Mastercard Level-2/Level-3 large-ticket interchange downgrade
platform_risks.trigger: Large vendors refusing card settlement or failing to pass Level-3 line-item tax/invoice metadata with the authorization
platform_risks.impact: Shift of specific vendors back to low-margin ACH or interchange rate step-down
platform_risks.detection_metric: Automated Level-2/Level-3 data-enrichment pass rate and per-vendor surcharge detection
platform_risks.fallback: Automatically inject Level-3 line-item invoice metadata at card creation, offer dynamic early-pay ACH discounts (1.5%–2% 10-day net) for card-averse vendors, and focus on fragmented long-tail vendor bases

plays.name: Newly Registered Domain (NRD) & DNS-Diagnostic Trigger Arbitrage
plays.mechanism: Ingest daily ICANN CZDS Newly Registered Domain (NRD) zone diffs and .us unredacted RDAP feeds, cross-match domain tokens against Secretary of State LLC filings to resolve physical mailing addresses despite WHOIS privacy, and run automated 72-hour DNS/HTTP probes (0 Google indexed pages, missing sitemap.xml, missing SPF/DMARC) to trigger personalized diagnostic mailers.
inputs: ICANN CZDS daily zone-file diffs & unredacted .us RDAP feeds
30-day Secretary of State LLC/Corp & USPTO entity cross-match index
Automated 72-hour DNS (SPF/DKIM/DMARC) & HTTP (sitemap.xml / Google index) scanner
workflow: Cross-match daily NRD registrations against new SOS LLC filings and .us RDAP records to resolve founder name and street address
Probe each resolved domain at 72 hours for unindexed status, missing sitemap.xml/robots.txt, and unconfigured SPF/DMARC email authentication

Dispatch a personalized diagnostic scorecard mailer with a QR code offering a $149 1-click Search Console + IndexNow + DNS/DMARC launch fix, recurring local SEO retainers, and high-CPA SaaS/hosting referrals
metrics: NRD-to-physical-address resolution rate (%)
QR diagnostic scan & $149 tripwire conversion %
Upsell rate to recurring SEO/AI agency retainers + affiliate EPC

platform_risks.trigger: Sending fake 'Domain Registry / Google Activation' bills or scraping RDAP endpoints above rate limits
platform_risks.impact: USPS mail-stop orders, merchant processor termination, or RDAP IP rate-limiting
platform_risks.detection_metric: Customer confusion inquiries, chargeback ratio >1%, and RDAP HTTP 429 response rate
platform_risks.fallback: Use ICANN CZDS bulk zone files + SOS LLC cross-matching instead of high-frequency WHOIS scraping, and present mailers strictly as a private technical diagnostic audit with real DNS/sitemap fixes

plays.name: Multi-Location Google Business Profile (GBP) Local-Pack Grid Arbitrage
plays.mechanism: Capture high-margin Google Maps 3-Pack calls across tier-2/3 metros by partnering with real, licensed local tradespeople to co-verify legitimate physical office/shop locations, wiring call-tracking numbers and review-automation workflows to monetize excess lead capacity.
inputs: Geo-grid rank tracker identifying low-review-count Map Pack gaps in $3k+ home/commercial verticals
Joint-venture co-verification agreements with real brick-and-mortar licensed contractors
Dynamic call routing (Ringba) + automated SMS post-job review velocity loop
workflow: Identify suburban and tier-2 metro sub-markets where top-3 Google Maps competitors have <40 reviews and weak category optimization
Sign a revenue-share or pay-per-call partnership with a real local contractor or commercial office tenant (never using fake UPS boxes or virtual coworking addresses)
Optimize GBP primary/secondary categories, service-area pages, and automated customer review requests to lock top-3 Map Pack placement and bill per qualified call
metrics: Local Geo-Grid Top-3 share of voice (%)
Qualified inbound Map Pack calls per location per month
Net revenue per location ($1,500–$6,000/mo) and partner retention

platform_risks.failure_mode: Google Business Profile video-verification failure or network-wide account suspension
platform_risks.trigger: Creating fake storefront listings at UPS stores, virtual offices, or residential addresses without signage/licensing
platform_risks.impact: Immediate GBP suspension and loss of all accumulated reviews and Map Pack calls
platform_risks.detection_metric: 100% physical signage, utility bill, and state contractor license verification readiness per profile
platform_risks.fallback: Only launch GBP profiles backed by a real partner's physical shop/yard capable of passing live video verification, and pair every listing with organic city rank-and-rent pages

plays.name: DNS/Script Technographic Drop-Off & Renewal-Window Interception
plays.mechanism: Crawl target commercial domains and DNS TXT/CNAME records weekly to detect the exact day a company installs or removes high-ticket enterprise software tags (Salesforce, HubSpot, Marketo, Segment, NetSuite), predicting annual renewal windows (Month 10–11) and active vendor migrations.
inputs: Weekly HTTP script-tag, DOM header, & DNS TXT/CNAME technographic crawler
Historical install-timestamp ledger (calculating 12-month contract renewal windows)
B2B executive contact graph & migration-agency/SaaS partner routing
workflow: Scan 500,000+ target B2B domains weekly for JavaScript SDKs, tracking pixels, and SPF/CNAME records of $20k–$150k/yr SaaS platforms
Flag accounts entering Month 10 of their annual contract (60 days before auto-renewal lock-in) or accounts running dual competing tags during a live evaluation
Route renewal-window and active-churn signals to competing SaaS sales teams, software resellers, and implementation agencies
metrics: Install/drop detection precision (%) and renewal-date accuracy
Outbound reply-to-demo conversion rate on Month-10 renewal targets
Per-opportunity bounty or retainer revenue per agency/SaaS partner

platform_risks.failure_mode: WAF/Cloudflare bot-blocking or false-positive tag detection from server-side GTM
platform_risks.trigger: High-concurrency crawling from datacenter IPs or misinterpreting server-side tag manager consolidation as vendor churn
platform_risks.impact: Incomplete technographic diffs or wasted sales outreach on false churn signals
platform_risks.detection_metric: Crawler HTTP 200 success rate and multi-signal verification (DNS SPF/CNAME + careers-page job-posting confirmation)
platform_risks.fallback: Combine passive DNS TXT/CNAME monitoring with job-posting technographic mentions to confirm true vendor switches before routing

plays.name: Subsidized / Developer-Tenant Multi-Inbox Cold Outbound Infrastructure
plays.mechanism: Provisioning hundreds of isolated secondary domains across subsidized Microsoft 365 developer/partner tenants, Cloudflare Email Routing, and low-cost SMTP relays—sending strictly 15–25 plain-text emails per inbox per day across 300+ free/subsidized mailboxes to deliver 150,000+ monthly B2B cold emails into primary inboxes without paying $6–$12/seat retail Google Workspace pricing.
inputs: Lookalike secondary domain portfolio with automated SPF, DKIM (2048-bit), DMARC (`p=quarantine`/`reject`), and custom tracking-free MX records
Subsidized M365 partner/developer tenants, Cloudflare Email Routing catch-alls, and distributed SMTP sending nodes
Automated peer-to-peer warmup network and master unibox reply-routing webhook
workflow: Provision 100–300 secondary sending domains and bind 2–3 mailboxes per domain via automated DNS and tenant scripts
Warm every mailbox for 14–21 days with realistic thread-depth conversations before introducing live outbound prospects
Cap daily outbound volume at <=20 zero-link, zero-tracking-pixel plain-text messages per mailbox per day to stay completely beneath ESP volume heuristics
Aggregate all prospect replies into a single unified AI-triaged inbox that books qualified B2B sales calls on pay-per-show or retainer terms
metrics: Primary-inbox placement rate (%) across Gmail and Microsoft 365 seed tests
All-in monthly infrastructure cost per 10,000 delivered plain-text emails ($)
Positive reply rate (%) and booked meetings per 1,000 prospects contacted

platform_risks.failure_mode: Tenant-wide outbound throttling or domain-footprint blacklisting (Spamhaus DBL)
platform_risks.trigger: Placing too many domains inside a single tenant, embedding tracking pixels, or exceeding 30 sends/day per mailbox
platform_risks.impact: Tenant suspension or domain-level spam-folder routing
platform_risks.detection_metric: Daily seed-list inbox placement (%) and bounce rate (<1.5% hard threshold)
platform_risks.fallback: Enforce max 2–3 domains per tenant, strip all open/click tracking pixels, verify 100% of leads via SMTP catch-all checks before sending, and keep hot-standby warmed domains ready for instant swap

plays.name: High-Velocity DM Outbound & Trigger Funnels
plays.mechanism: Replace blind cold mass-DM blasts (which die to PeerFloodError and silent Message Request graveyards) with high-velocity comment-to-DM triggers, hand-raiser reaction hooks, and multi-inbox warm signal routing.
inputs: Short-form / community trigger posts ('Comment KEYWORD')
Signal-verified prospect handles
Automated DM qualification & booking bridge
workflow: Publish high-curiosity teardown or resource posts where prospects comment a trigger keyword or react to unlock a playbook or calculator
Deliver instant automated DM replies to warm hand-raisers (bypassing cold-DM filters because the user initiated interaction) or send contextual 1-to-1 DMs referencing an active public request
Qualify budget and timeline inside a 3-message DM micro-funnel and transition immediately to a booked call, checkout link, or owned SMS/email list
metrics: Trigger-comment to DM delivery rate
DM reply-to-qualified-conversation %
Revenue per 100 DM threads

platform_risks.failure_mode: PeerFloodError, shadow-filtering into 'Hidden Requests', or link-domain blacklisting
platform_risks.trigger: Sending identical unsolicited cold DMs with raw external URLs across freshly registered or SIM-farmed accounts
platform_risks.impact: Near-0% inbox placement, outbound DM block, or permanent account suspension
platform_risks.detection_metric: Seen/reply ratio below 10% and outbound PeerFloodError / action-block frequency
platform_risks.fallback: Require user-initiated trigger action (comment/reaction/inbound message) before automated DM dispatch and send external links only after the prospect replies

plays.name: "Free LLC / Free Setup" Fintech Account Co-Registration Bounty Stacking
plays.mechanism: Offering a $0-service-fee LLC formation and business-launch concierge (borrower pays only mandatory state filing fees) that embeds a sequential post-formation 'Required Business Infrastructure Checklist' where every newly formed entity opens free business banking, corporate card, payroll, bookkeeping, and merchant accounts—yielding $600–$1,800+ in stacked B2B fintech CPA bounties per free formation.
inputs: High-intent 'free LLC formation' and 'start a business in [State]' search, social, and creator traffic
Automated state SOS filing workflow, EIN retrieval assistant, and operating-agreement generator
Direct B2B partner/CPA agreements with neobank, corporate card, payroll, and registered-agent providers
workflow: Acquire first-time founders via a genuine $0-markup LLC formation funnel where the user pays only state statutory fees
Guide the founder through an automated EIN and corporate-resolution wizard immediately upon state filing submission

Present an integrated 1-click onboarding sequence for a free business checking account ($150–$400 CPA), corporate charge card ($200–$500 CPA), payroll/bookkeeping trial ($100–$300 CPA), and web/domain host ($100–$200 CPA)
Provide automated compliance reminders and annual report tracking to capture recurring Year-2 registered-agent renewals
metrics: Stacked fintech CPA bounty revenue ($) realized per 100 free LLC formations
Post-EIN bank-account funding conversion rate (%) within 14 days of formation
Net customer acquisition margin after paid search/creator traffic spend

platform_risks.failure_mode: Fintech partner CPA clawback or payout tier downgrade due to unfunded/dormant business bank accounts
platform_risks.trigger: Sending low-intent formations that open free business bank accounts but never complete KYC or initial deposit funding
platform_risks.impact: Reversal of unvested CPA bounties or shift from account-open CPA to funded-account CPA tiers
platform_risks.detection_metric: 30-day funded-account activation rate (%) and average initial deposit balance across referred LLCs
platform_risks.fallback: Gate free operating-agreement and bookkeeping templates behind verified bank-account funding and pre-qualify founders on 30-day operating revenue intent

plays.name: Whitelisted Agency Ad-Spend Card-Multiplier Points & Volume-Rebate Cycling
plays.mechanism: Route genuine client-authorized advertising spend through eligible agency payment arrangements to earn contract-permitted rewards and volume rebates, net of financing, processing, and client pass-through obligations.
inputs: Client media mandates and rebate ownership clauses
Issuer reward categories, caps, and repayment terms
Platform invoices and agency volume-rebate agreements
workflow: 1. Verify client authorization, platform payment permissions, and ownership of rewards and rebates
2. Model eligible media purchases against reward caps, fees, liquidity, and rebate thresholds
3. Pay only genuine approved advertising invoices without circular spend or fabricated transactions
4. Reconcile settled rewards, client credits, refunds, and full card repayment each statement cycle
metrics: Net retained rewards and rebates per media dollar
Unfunded client exposure and repayment coverage
Invoice-to-reward reconciliation variance

platform_risks.failure_mode: Reward clawback or client-funded liquidity shortfall
platform_risks.trigger: Ineligible categories, prohibited payment aggregation, or delayed client reimbursement
platform_risks.impact: Lost rebates, interest costs, and card suspension
platform_risks.detection_metric: Denied reward value and overdue client balances versus cash reserves
platform_risks.fallback: Move to client-direct billing or prefunded approved agency terms and stop rewards-dependent spending

plays.name: Web2App Quiz Funnel & App-Store 30%-Fee Subscription Billing Bypass
plays.mechanism: Acquire subscribers through a transparent web quiz and permitted external checkout before app access, comparing actual regional store fees and entitlements rather than assuming a universal 30% saving.
inputs: Consent-based quiz and acquisition analytics
Storefront-specific external billing and entitlement rules
Payment fees, subscription disclosures, and cancellation flows
workflow: 1. Map each storefront and app category to current external billing and linking permissions
2. Build a minimal-data quiz with clear recurring price, trial expiry, and cancellation disclosure
3. Route eligible users through compliant web checkout and synchronize app entitlements
4. Reconcile taxes, refunds, churn, and store charges against in-app billing economics
metrics: Net subscription contribution after all fees
Quiz-to-paid conversion and retained subscriber rate
Refund, chargeback, and cancellation completion rates

platform_risks.failure_mode: Store rejection or deceptive-subscription enforcement
platform_risks.trigger: Unpermitted external purchase links or hidden recurring charges
platform_risks.impact: Distribution loss, refunds, and payment-provider restrictions
platform_risks.detection_metric: Store review violations and billing-related complaint rate
platform_risks.fallback: Use approved in-app billing where required and simplify subscription disclosures and cancellation

plays.name: UCC-1 Filing, MCA Stacking & Maturity-Date Trigger Arbitrage
plays.mechanism: Monitor state Secretary of State UCC-1 financing statements and continuation filings to identify operating businesses 4–9 months into high-cost Merchant Cash Advances (MCAs) or equipment notes, triggering refinance and debt-consolidation live transfers.
inputs: Daily state SOS UCC-1 initial, amendment, & termination bulk feeds
Secured-party lender dictionary (identifying MCA vs. bank/SBA filings)
Live-transfer commercial refinance & SBA consolidation desk
workflow: Classify daily UCC-1 filings by secured party to isolate businesses that took high-cost short-term working capital 120–240 days ago
Enrich business owner direct phone and email and score by industry revenue stability
Contact merchants during peak renewal/payoff windows to offer lower-rate term consolidation or equipment refinancing, monetizing via broker points or live-transfer fees
metrics: UCC-to-verified-decision-maker match rate (%)
Live-transfer qualification rate (%)
Origination commission / referral fee per funded refi
